messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up—candidate Kiran Desai (senior infra) coming onsite 2026-09-03. Flight lands 08:40 local, loop 11:00-15:30. Requests: ASL interpreter for first 90m, nut-free lunch, short escorted walk from drop-off (uses cane), and a small table for laptop + notes. Also asked about local transit reimbursement. Can we confirm logistics?
Ellis Carter: I can book rooms. Recommend Quiet Room D for the interviewing + table. Will block 10:45-16:00 and include a 10m buffer between sessions.
Juno Park: ASL interpreter—I can book through our vendor. Want me to request realtime captions too?
Maya Singh: Please do both: ASL interpreter for 11:00-12:30 and Live Captions during the whole loop. Mark accessibility on invites.
Recruiter - Priya: Confirmed Kiran's name (as on passport). I've told them we cover local transit (up to $60). I'll send reimbursement link after visit.
Facilities: Reserved Visitor Spot L2-12 from 09:00-18:00. We'll place a temporary ramp mat at the main entrance. Escort service available from drop-off; who will meet?
Maya Singh: I can probably make it, but flying from a different airport. Ellis, can you meet at 08:50 and escort to front desk if I'm delayed?
Ellis Carter: Yep, I'll meet them at 08:50. Front Desk, please hold an envelope labeled "Kiran Desai" with badge + interpreter pass.
Front Desk: Acknowledged. Badge will be printed and envelope held. ID check required at pickup.
Juno Park: Interpreter vendor confirmed. ASL interpreter (Ana M.) booked 11:00-12:30. Live captions vendor booked for 11:00-16:00. I'll DM details to interviewers.
Maya Singh: Loaner laptop? Candidate prefers to use their own, but asked for a USB-C hub. Do we have one?
Facilities: USB-C hub available (asset H-19). We'll place it in the envelope with badge.
Recruiter - Priya: Kiran asked about quiet place to breastfeed/express (partner situation). We have lactation room; code 2248 for that day. I'll include it in the candidate notes.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: badge, parking, ramp, ASL, captions, USB hub, nut-free lunch, lactation room. Travel monitor enabled for flight KI-712.
Ellis Carter: Catering ordered for 12:30: nut-free + vegan option, plated individually. Seating for 6 (candidate + 5). Delivery to lounge 12:20.
Maya Singh: Great. Who will greet Kiran if Ellis gets pulled? Priya, can you have the recruiter stop by the lobby around arrival?
Recruiter - Priya: Yes I can be there at 08:40 for a quick meet-and-greet. Will hand Kiran the expense form and lactation code.
PeopleOps Bot: Flight KI-712 status: scheduled. Will post gate and delay alerts here. :airplane:
Maya Singh: Thanks all. I'll upload the accommodation note to the candidate doc and add the ASL details. Please flag if anything changes. :pray:
